scope: F4-01 security patch: require holder-controlled operator approval; default regression and invariant suite, focused OpenSea tests, static review and local lifecycle verification.

fixedFinding.title: Payout wallet can seize holder NFTs through validator auto-approval
fixedFinding.fix: Read the OpenZeppelin 4.8.3 ERC721 holder approval mapping directly; inherited creator auto-approval flag has no effect on isApprovedForAll.

focusedTests.signatures: Local test signatures; not live OpenSea API

staticReview.detail: The same bounded AuctionEdition.mint loop has a new source-dependent ID; its explanation and the other 28 finding IDs are unchanged. Source pin refreshed after review.

fullAudit.extendedProfile: The 10000-run fuzz and 1000-by-256 invariant audit profile was not rerun for 4.0.1; default-profile results above are current.

acceptedDesignFinding.title: payout wallet can confiscate all bidder refunds

limitations: Already deployed immutable contracts are not upgraded by this source patch.
Validator/policy administration remains trusted and can weaken royalties, but cannot manufacture holder approvals.
F4-02, F4-03, F4-04 and F4-06 remain recorded in the issue register.
Live OpenSea Studio activation and real API listing/buy/offer verification remain required.
The inherited auto-approval getter can report true; that flag cannot authorize transfers in this edition.
